To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the chromosome 17 QTL affecting spatial navigation performance in Dahl rats was delimited to a 10 Mbp region.
the Nav-5 QLT is delimited to the chromosome 1 65.02-74.66 Mpb segment in Dahl rats.

a quantitative trait locus (Nav-5) linked with ability for finding a platform in the MWM was located on chromosome (chr) 17 using intercross between two rat strains (Dahl S and Dahl R) that differ in the ability to learn the MWM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the gene variant responsible for Nav-5 phenotype.
the identification of a novel QTL linked to spatial learning and memory, which is located on rat chromosome 17.
the identification and functional characterization of a novel gene variant that affects spatial learning and memory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Nav-5 is located in a 10 Mbp region on chromosome 17 in Dahl rats.
Nav-5 QLT has been mapped to a <10 Mbp region on chromosome 17.
the Nav-5 QTLS is defined to the 65–75 Mbp region of rat chromosome 17.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Nav-5 QL on chromosome 17 in Dahl rats affects spatial navigation in MWM and that the Nav-4 and Nav-5 QTLS on chromosome 1 and 17, respectively, are independent and additive.
the spatial navigation performance in the Morris water-maze task is influenced by a gene(s) in the chromosome 17 region 65.02-74.66 Mpb.
the S × R intercross identified a chromosome 17 spatial navigation QTL (Nav-5) and that congenic strains confirmed and defined the Nav-5 QTLS to <10 Mpb.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Nav-5 QL is located within a narrow region on chromosome 17, and that it is likely to contain a single gene.
we were able to confirm and further define the Nav-5 Qtl to <10 Mpb.
a QTL for spatial learning and memory can be mapped to a small region on rat chromosome 17.
